tool.name: Combine Shigella report
tool.description: join ShigaPass and Mykrobe reports with cross-check warnings
tool.command: @CLI@ combine --shigapass #for $r in $shigapass '$r' #end for --mykrobe #for $r in $mykrobe '$r' #end for $strip_suffixes --outdir out

param.name: shigapass
param.label: ShigaPass report(s)
param.help: From ShigaPass typing (one report or several).

param.name: mykrobe
param.label: Mykrobe report(s)
param.help: From Mykrobe Shigella genotyping: a collection of per-sample reports or one report.

param.name: strip_suffixes
param.label: Ignore file-name suffixes when matching samples
param.help: Match after removing _assembly, _contigs, .contigs, .fasta, .fastq, .fna, .fa, .fq. Off: names must match exactly.

has_line_matching.expression: ^ERR5888634\t.*\tNo Mykrobe genotyping scheme for S\. boydii; serotype only\t.*
^SWAP\t.*\tDiscordant: ShigaPass S\. sonnei, Mykrobe S\. flexneri - check\t.*

tool.help:
**What it does**
Joins the reports of *ShigaPass typing* and *Mykrobe Shigella genotyping* on the sample name and adds cross-check warnings. One row per sample. The same combined report comes from *ShigaPass typing* with *Also run Mykrobe genotyping* set to *Yes*.
Sample names must match exactly unless *Ignore file-name suffixes* is on. In a workflow, keep the collection element names the same in both branches (assemblers mapped over the reads collection keep them).
**Cross-check warnings**
========================================================================= ========================================================================== Situation Warning ========================================================================= ========================================================================== ShigaPass *S. sonnei*, Mykrobe *S. flexneri* (or the reverse) ``Discordant: ShigaPass <call>, Mykrobe <species> - check`` ShigaPass *S. sonnei* / *S. flexneri* 1-5, Mykrobe none matched ``ShigaPass <call> but Mykrobe did not match the <scheme> scheme - check reads/assembly`` ShigaPass Not Shigella/EIEC, Mykrobe *S. sonnei* / *S. flexneri* ``Discordant: ShigaPass Not Shigella/EIEC, Mykrobe <species> - check assembly`` ShigaPass *S. boydii*, *S. dysenteriae*, *S. flexneri* 6 or EIEC ``No Mykrobe genotyping scheme for <species>; serotype only`` (expected) ShigaPass Not Shigella/EIEC and Mykrobe Not E. coli/Shigella ``Not Shigella - check organism`` Sample in one report only ``Missing from Mykrobe report`` / ``Missing from ShigaPass report`` Duplicate sample names the job fails and lists the duplicates ========================================================================= ==========================================================================
Warnings from the two tools (e.g. borderline species coverage) are kept.
**Output columns**
The ShigaPass columns (sample to serotype_shigapass), the Mykrobe columns (mykrobe_scheme to additional_markers), one ``warnings`` column, then shigapass_version, mykrobe_version, mykrobe_panel_version, tool_version.
